deploy.install: deno task --cwd ../.. content:generate && deno task --cwd ../.. fonts:generate && deno install --frozen=false --allow-scripts=npm:sharp

tasks.dev: deno task --cwd ../.. fonts:generate && deno task --cwd ../.. images:generate && deno task --cwd ../.. content:generate && deno run --unstable-kv -A npm:vite@8.1.3 dev
tasks.build: deno task --cwd ../.. prepare && deno task build:prepared
tasks.check: deno run -A npm:@sveltejs/kit@2.69.2 sync && deno run -A npm:svelte-check@4.4.6 --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
tasks.build:prepared: deno run -A npm:vite@8.1.3 build && deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/link-prerendered-assets.ts
tasks.storybook: deno task --cwd ../.. fonts:generate && deno run -A npm:storybook@10.4.6 dev -p 6006 --no-open
tasks.build:storybook: deno task --cwd ../.. fonts:generate && deno run -A npm:storybook@10.4.6 build --quiet
tasks.test:storybook: deno task build:storybook && deno run -A scripts/check-storybook.ts
